bugLogs.title: Low contrast on promo text in home page
steps_to_reproduce: Observe the text color #d9c27a on background #ffe9a8
bugLogs.expected_behavior: Text must have a contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1 against its background for normal text
bugLogs.actual_behavior: Text has a contrast ratio of 1.46:1, far below the required threshold
bugLogs.suggested_fix: In the CSS rule for div, change color from #d9c27a to #756942 (4.53:1 on #ffe9a8; measured 1.46:1, required 4.5:1).

bugLogs.title: Missing lang attribute on <html> element
steps_to_reproduce: Inspect the <html> tag in the page source
bugLogs.expected_behavior: The <html> element must have a valid lang attribute (e.g., <html lang="en">) so assistive technologies can determine the page language.
bugLogs.actual_behavior: The <html> element has no lang attribute, causing assistive technologies to default to an incorrect language or fail to apply proper pronunciation rules.
bugLogs.suggested_fix: Add a lang attribute to the <html> tag, e.g., <html lang="en">, ensuring the value matches the primary language of the page content.

bugLogs.title: Missing alt text on hero image
bugLogs.expected_behavior: The image should have a descriptive alt attribute that conveys its purpose to assistive technologies.
bugLogs.actual_behavior: The element has no alt attribute, aria-label, aria-labelledby, title, or role="none"/"presentation".
bugLogs.suggested_fix: Add a descriptive alt attribute to the image:

bugLogs.title: Cart link has no discernible text
steps_to_reproduce: Tab to the cart icon link
Observe that the link has no visible or accessible text
bugLogs.expected_behavior: The link should have an accessible name that describes its purpose, such as "View cart" or "Go to shopping cart", so that screen readers and keyboard users can identify it.
bugLogs.actual_behavior: The element is focusable but contains no text, aria-label, aria-labelledby, or title attribute, making it invisible to assistive technologies.
bugLogs.suggested_fix: Add an accessible name to the link: or include descriptive text inside the element. Ensure the selector a.icon-link is updated accordingly.

bugLogs.title: Missing persistent label for email input
steps_to_reproduce: Locate the email input field with placeholder 'Your email address'
bugLogs.expected_behavior: The input field should have a visible, persistent label that remains when the field is focused or filled.
bugLogs.actual_behavior: The input field relies solely on placeholder text, which disappears on focus and provides no accessible name.
bugLogs.suggested_fix: Add a visible label element associated with the input: <label for="news-email">Email address</label> before the input, or add aria-label="Email address" to the input. Ensure the label is visible and not hidden by CSS.
